correctness.rationale: Hajja's equiareality condition places every distinct reciprocal balloon radius among the positive roots of a quartic whose linear coefficient vanishes. Four distinct positive roots would have positive third elementary symmetric sum, contradicting that zero linear coefficient, so four classes are impossible. For the proposed dimension-eight multiplicities 1,3,5, the inspected exact-rational verifier proves both polynomial factorizations imposing the quartic coefficient conditions, isolates the unique root b in the stated rational interval, proves c>1, and verifies Hajja's existence quantity M^2-7N is positive. An independent symbolic replay reproduced the factorization data, the selected real root b approximately 0.24795364834026344, c approximately 1.3453685908429687, and positive existence margin.

originality.rationale: Hajja derives the same governing quartic, completely handles the two-value case, and explicitly leaves the existence of three and four distinct balloon-radius values unaddressed. The submitted result resolves both remaining branches: the missing linear term rules out four positive roots, while the exact algebraic construction realizes three. The later Wu--Zhang paper studies circumradius for the same simplex class rather than equiareality or the number of balloon-radius classes. Resultary search found the audited exact result and no prior covering resolution.
